coder_notes: Non-interventional-drug diagnostic study (registered phase NA); interventions are only diagnostic sampling, no drugs. Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype is one of three eligible glioma cohorts. IDH row is an entry requirement defining cohorts (IDH-mutant grade 2/3 or IDH-wildtype GBM); IDH immunostaining is also a secondary outcome. Ki-67 index treated as routine histology and not recorded. Gadolinium appears only as an MRI outcome descriptor, not as an intervention.
